Story Of The Year Shares Spooky New Music Video For “See Through”

Maria Serra September 28, 2026 News
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:39
Instaread

Following the winter release of their new album A.R.S.O.N., Story Of The Year has revealed the official visuals for the LP’s focus track, “See Through.” Excitingly, the visuals offer the exact spooky and over-the-top vibes you need for a solid Halloween celebration.

The new music video, directed by Jordan Phoenix, sees lead vocalist Dan Marsala living his best mad scientist life as he tries to build his dream girl.

Check out the lab results in Story Of The Year’s new music video below.

Silverstein and Story Of The Year are performing a co-headlining tour this fall and winter with friends Stand Atlantic and Footballhead as support. Check out the tour dates below and secure tickets here.
